reviews.review: Welcome to Warhammer meets Gears of War quite literally. No need to get an Xbox, this game is the perfect suffice and has a good amount of skill and difficulty involved. Fight for power as the noble Space Marines against the bloodthirsty Greenskins in an ever-raging bloody violent war.

Oh God the multiplayer it's so grimdark it'll blow your head off and replace it with some sort of robotic prayer skull. But seriously, the campaign is so-so... the multiplayer is the most fun I've had since the first Halo.
One of my all time faves

I was quite intrigued by this game when starting it as it's is unusual to see a non-strategy Warhammer game. I found the early part of the game a bit boring but it get's more interesting and enjoyable as the game progresses and you unlock more weapons and there's a greater variety of enemies. Plowing headfirst into a group of Orks with a chainsaw is always a lot of fun and there's plenty to fight. This game is a mix of hack and slash and shooting and resembles Gears Of War a little.

The strength of this game is how well it brings the Warhammer 40k universe to life. The Space Marines are really tough and disciplined and very serious and humourless while the Orks are crazy and violent and the industrial world setting of the game is grim and bleak. The whole atmosphere and look of the game is brilliant.

The story is a little predictable but still not bad and the open ending leaves room for a sequel which i would like to see. I know the chances are slim since THQ went bust but hopefully a sequel will get made at some point.

I did give the multiplayer a brief try but couldn't really get into it. Not necessarily because it's bad but more to do with the fact the majority of other players are high levelled with much better equipment while you start of with very basic equipment. It can be very difficult to get the kills required to level up so if you do want to commit to the multiplayer you will need to suffer through for a while.

Overall this is a decent game that offers a few hours of fun and would be appreciated by Warhammer 40k fans especially. It's a 7/10 for me.
